privacy.metaDescription: TraceIMEI-BJ privacy policy — compliant with Beninese law n° 2017-20 on the digital code.
privacy.intro: TraceIMEI-BJ processes your data in strict compliance with Beninese law n° 2017-20 of 20 April 2018 on the digital code of the Republic of Benin.
privacy.geoText: Compliant with Beninese law n° 2017-20 on the digital code. No exact GPS coordinates are collected or stored. Location data is limited to neighborhood level only.
privacy.data1: Account: email address, hashed password, assigned role (individual, dealer, technician, investigator, admin).
privacy.data2: IMEI verifications: verified IMEI number, returned status, ML score, timestamp.
privacy.data3: Theft reports: brand, model, IMEI, description, neighborhood, theft date, optional photo.
privacy.data4: No exact GPS coordinates are requested, collected or stored.
privacy.geoSectionText: Report location is strictly limited to the closed list of Cotonou neighborhoods (Akpakpa, Cadjehoun, Dantokpa, Fidjrossè, Godomey, Houéyiho, Missèbo, Sainte-Rita, Vèdoko, Zogbo, Agla). On the investigator map, markers are displayed at the neighborhood's approximate centroid (~500 m precision) — never at a specific address.
privacy.sec1: Passwords stored hashed (never in plain text).
privacy.sec2: Data access protected by Row-Level Security (RLS) at the database level.
privacy.sec3: Roles are stored in a dedicated table — privilege escalation is impossible.
privacy.sec4: The reports map is only accessible to investigator and admin roles.
privacy.sec5: TLS-encrypted connection across the entire user journey.
privacy.rightsIntro: Pursuant to articles 391 et seq. of the digital code, you have the following rights:
privacy.right1: Right of access to your personal data.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us at the address listed in the footer. A response will be provided within 30 days.
privacy.ret2: Theft reports: kept until status is resolved, then 24 months.
privacy.ret3: Account: kept as long as you use it. Permanent deletion on request.
